---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of the problem. Ex. My Content Block field
of type [...] always renders as [...] and I need [...]

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen — ideally the
JSON output you expect. If one of the existing extension points fits your
case, mention it: custom normalizer, field value transformer, `headless.yaml`
image processing or a processor option (see the
[documentation](https://github.com/Netzbewegung-Backend/nb_headless_content_blocks/tree/master/docs)).

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features
you've considered (e.g. a custom normalizer vs. a new processor option).

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the feature request here — e.g. the Content
Block definition (`config.yaml`) of the affected field.
